title: The Day I Thought I Lost My Angel
subtitle: When Silence Was Louder Than Words
quote: Sometimes, the deepest pain comes not from goodbye... but from silence.
endQuote: I thought May 22 had ended our story forever. I believed I had lost my angel. But destiny had one more surprise waiting for both of us.

content.text: By the time May arrived, Grace and I had become inseparable.
Our conversations had become part of our daily lives.
If one of us disappeared for even a few hours...
That was how close we had become.
I believed nothing could change what we shared.
It started like any other day.
One misunderstanding is enough to change an entire day.
A small disagreement slowly turned into a serious argument.
Neither of us intended to hurt the other.
The more we tried to explain ourselves...
The more we misunderstood each other.
I kept opening WhatsApp every few minutes.
I didn't know what to say.
I had never imagined a day without talking to Grace.
That day had become a reality.
I saw the places where we used to laugh together.
The bench where we spent hours talking.
The pathway we walked after classes.
That night was one of the longest nights of my life.
"Will she ever talk to me again?"
For the first time since she entered my life...
But of losing someone who had become part of my everyday happiness.
Every notification made my heart race.
But none of them were from Grace.
I smiled in front of everyone.
I realized something during those silent days.
You only understand someone's value when their absence begins to hurt more than their presence ever did.
I looked up at the sky as the sun disappeared behind the campus buildings.
Those words were painful to say.
Because I had imagined so many memories with her.
I wasn't ready to let them go.
I wasn't ready to accept a life where Grace was no longer part of it.
Life doesn't tell us what will happen next.
It only asks us to wait.
And although I didn't know it then...
Our story... was far from over.
It was only the beginning of another chapter.
